name: secondu-team-product-delivery
description: Turn evidence into product decisions, engineering checks and a reviewable delivery plan.

displayDescription.zh: 从需求证据到产品取舍、工程可行性与发布验收，形成可执行的交付方案。
displayDescription.en: Turn evidence into product decisions, engineering checks and a reviewable delivery plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据这份需求和现有方案，评审下一版本的范围、风险和验收条件。
quickPrompts.en: Review this requirement and proposal for next-release scope, risks and acceptance.

description.zh: 逐条整理用户材料、已知行为与待验证假设。保留原文出处；没有用户研究时明确证据缺口。交付 evidence.md。
description.en: Separate supplied evidence from assumptions with source references; expose missing research. Deliver evidence.md.

description.zh: 读取证据文件，比较至少两种适用方案；给出目标用户、取舍、最小范围、排除项、度量和验收草案。交付 proposal.md。
description.en: Read evidence and compare viable options. State audience, trade-offs, minimum scope, exclusions, metrics and draft acceptance. Deliver proposal.md.

description.zh: 核对已提供代码或架构；未提供时只列待检查问题。说明依赖、复杂度、迁移和失败路径，禁止把估计称为实测。交付 feasibility.md。
description.en: Inspect supplied implementation or architecture; otherwise identify open checks. Record dependencies, complexity, migration and failures, distinguishing estimates from measurements. Deliver feasibility.md.

description.zh: 打开前序文件，检查需求、方案和可行性是否冲突；按关键路径设计可执行验收，列出阻断项、负责人和通过依据。交付 acceptance.md。
description.en: Open prior deliverables, check contradictions, and derive executable acceptance by critical path. Identify blockers, owners and evidence. Deliver acceptance.md.
